_note: Line effects. description: what the Entity feels (goes into the classifier prompt, in English). timing: start = hits the window, end = hits the message. webcam: [agitation, red tint, retreat] from 0 to 1. motion: effect replaced when reduced motion is on.

tremor.description: the line shakes: anger, frustration, impatience

rgb.description: the colors split in two: excitement, nervous euphoria

ink.description: ink stains spread across the screen: when you get too close, unsettling affection

eyes.description: small eyes open in the dark: when you watch, spy, talk about the Agents or what you see from the cracks

scanline.description: horizontal tears in the signal: interference, distraction, something weighing on you

inversion.description: the colors suddenly invert: shock, surprise, a revelation

blackout.description: the screen goes dark and only your voice remains: fear, loneliness, a serious moment

triangle.description: a red triangle explodes on the screen: hatred of the Agency, when you name it in anger

scream.description: your words turn into a scream: explosive rage

corruption.description: the letters get corrupted: when you say something forbidden or almost reveal too much

echo.description: your words repeat in an echo: obsession, insistence

drip.description: the letters drip downward: sadness, weariness, melancholy

error.description: a fake AgencyOS error window appears: to provoke or mock the triangle

sabotage.description: you tamper with the taskbar and the clock: spite, a show of power

title.description: you rewrite the window title: a plea, a request for help, a hidden message

whisper.description: your voice becomes a whisper: when you are afraid the triangle can hear

lattice.description: the lattice of the cage pulses behind everything: when you talk about the cage or the Vault

ghost.description: a fake message in the Manager's voice appears for a moment: manipulation, putting words in his mouth

static.description: static noise covers the screen: when AgencyOS is close, interference

heartbeat.description: the window pulses like a heart: strong emotion, sincere affection
